LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: when using the digital device for learners with visual difficulties. 1. How are phrasal verbs formed? 2. How can one tell the meaning of a phrasal verb?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the role of phrasal verbs in making conversations interesting. • Read a text and isolate the phrasal verbs formed from make, pass and look, • Search the internet for more examples of the given phrasal verbs and list them on different flash cards, Adjust light intensity when using the digital device for learners with visual difficulties. 1. How are phrasal verbs formed? 2. How can one tell the meaning of a phrasal verb? 108 • Work with peers to construct sentences on modern fashion using the given phrasal verbs, • Use print and digital dictionaries of phrasal verbs to check the meaning of the given phrasal verbs, with peers. Learners who may not turn pages to use page turners or be supported by peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication is enhanced as the learner learns to speak clearly and effectively through correct use of phrasal verbs.

• Digital literacy is developed as the learner checks the meanings of phrasal verbs from digital dictionaries.

Values:
Unity is promoted as the learner makes contributions in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Cultural awareness is promoted as the learner constructs sentences on modern fashion.
